copper_potential_file_subtask_quenching.name: Copper Potential File for Quenching
copper_potential_file_subtask_quenching.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Copper for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

copper_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.name: Copper NPT Cooling
copper_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible molten Copper structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate quenching process of Copper by cooling its molten structure under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the cooled structure and density in gm/cm^3.
copper_npt_cooling_subtask_quenching.submission_format: {"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

copper_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching.name: Copper NPT Relaxation for Quenching
copper_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Copper structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the structure under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure and density in gm/cm^3.
copper_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching.submission_format: {"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

copper_nvt_relaxation_subtask_quenching.name: Copper NVT Relaxation for Quenching
copper_nvt_relaxation_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Copper structure and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the structure under NVT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Report the final density in g/cm^3.
